items.question: What does Devynix do?
items.answer: Devynix builds focused technology products for specific industries — GeoNix for geospatial and land-use intelligence, and FinNix for personal finance. We are a product company, not a generic software agency.

items.question: Do you take on custom software projects?
items.answer: No. We do not build bespoke software for hire. Our engineering effort goes into GeoNix and FinNix, and it grows as those products grow.

items.question: How do you work with AI?
items.answer: We use AI — including small language models, RAG, and predictive ML — where it creates measurable value inside GeoNix or FinNix, not as a marketing claim.

items.question: Can GeoNix or FinNix fit our existing systems?
items.answer: Both products are built to fit real data and workflow contexts in Latin America. We do not build custom integrations outside of GeoNix and FinNix themselves.

items.question: How do you decide what to build?
items.answer: We confirm a real industry problem before committing engineering time to it. Each product exists because the problem behind it was validated first, not assumed.

items.question: How can I reach you?
items.answer: The fastest way is WhatsApp. You can also email us — both routes reach the same team.
